room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment on every admissible claim

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year (whichever lower); listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, HIFU, etc.) capped at 50% of SI

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate on claim; max 50% of SI. Alternatively, insured may opt for No Claim Discount on premium instead

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in the policy

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, HIFU, balloon sinuplasty, deep brain stimulation, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections, green/holmium laser prostate, IONM, stem cell therapy covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Gloves, consumables listed in Annexure A List I as non-payable items

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary & OPD, maternity, sterility/infertility, overseas treatment, war, nuclear/bio/chemical, obesity surgery (unless criteria met), gender change
optional_riders: No optional riders mentioned in this policy wording
insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
